_comment: Content map for the Preparedness Archive (Issue #136). 'status' is internal tracking only and must never be rendered publicly for unpublished items.

sections.label: Start Here
sections.blurb: A calm progression: the first hour, the first 72 hours, the first two weeks.

sections.label: Water
sections.blurb: How much to store, how to keep it clean, and how to make questionable water safer, with the limits stated plainly.

sections.label: Food and Preservation
sections.blurb: Pantry-first planning and food safety that follows tested USDA and extension methods.

sections.label: Shelter, Heat and Power
sections.blurb: Staying put or leaving, staying warm or cool, and running equipment without carbon monoxide.

sections.label: Health and Sanitation
sections.blurb: Medication, devices, hygiene, and waste when services fail.

sections.label: Family and Personal Safety
sections.blurb: Plans a household actually rehearses: fire escape, reunification, warnings, communication.

sections.label: The Lost Ways
sections.blurb: How earlier generations managed without modern infrastructure, with a modern safety verdict on every method.

sections.label: Field Tools and Printables
sections.blurb: Free worksheets and checklists that run in your browser and keep your information on your device.

section_label_reconciliation: Issue #136 lists 8 URL slugs; the founder brief names 6 labelled sections. Slugs follow the issue (master spec). 'water' + 'health-sanitation' together cover 'Water and Sanitation'; 'family-communication' carries the label 'Family and Personal Safety'. Founder to confirm.

modern.label: Act now
modern.blurb: Current, source-dated guidance a household can use today.

lost-ways.label: The Lost Ways
lost-ways.blurb: Documented historical practice. Historical accuracy is not modern safety approval.

verdicts.not-validated: Not validated for modern household use
